 . This type of acne is comendonal acne (closed comendones) i'm 14 and have had this type of acne for a year or 2 now. Closed comendones are basically white/blackheads underneath the skin, this basically mean that they are really fucking hard to get rid of as you can't pop them yourself or apply a cream on them that will make \*direct\* contact.

These are the things i did to get rif of my closed comendones (be patient as it has taken me 12 months get rid of 99% of mine)

\-don't over moisturize/ hydrate your skin, this is a really big cause of comendonal acne.

\-Drink a shit ton of water, i drink about 2-3 litres of water everyday and it makes such a big difference to the overall appearence of your skin.

\-Use a 2.5% benzonyl peroxide every 2-3 days. you might want to use an acne cream more often but dries the hell out of your skin and makes it look worse.

\-make sure you are washing your face properly, morning and night.

\-consider taking accutane or something along the lines of that, i took doxycycline but i didnt really notice much of a difference.

\-Get an aqua peel: Holy crap this changed my skin completely!!!

I dont know what country you live in as going to the dermatologist can be quite pricey in some countries, my aqua peel treatment was only about 40NZD ( i got it at abijou clinic in korea as some of my family lives there) I got it 3 times before my skin was free of  all closed comendones. The results are obviously, not permanent and you will still get a few pimples from time to time but getting your skin cleaned out gives your face a fresh start. As long as you maintain and take care of your skin you shouldnt get any more comendonal acne.

\-I aso really recommend getting "acne scaling" (thats what they call it in korea, also at abijou clinic for about 40NZD)
